CustomField.description: Orders on this code that were PAID - maintained by the Discount Code Times Redeemed rollup over Transaction__c. It was called "Times Redeemed", and that name cost an afternoon: a check order is a redemption and creates no Transaction__c, so this sat at zero while real orders came in and the code looked unused. It is one half of the answer. Total Redemptions is the answer.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Orders on this code whose payment has settled. Read Total Redemptions for how many times the code has actually been used - a check order is a redemption too, and it never appears here.
CustomField.label: Paid Redemptions
